Ah yes.  With only 8 cards drawn, it would seem to focus on out-of-turn draws.

 

Does anybody that hasn't unlocked yet want to do some experimentation for us?  The process is:

1: Set up a matches with Guise, Visionary and Team Leader Tachyon on the team against a Villain and Environment that won't force you to draw cards (Ambuscade and Silver Gulch perhaps).

2: Start at 1 out-of turn draw

3: Ensure TLT and Visionary use their powers to give Guise exactly that many out-of-turn draws.

4: The only things that Guise should do on his turns is play each one-shot at least once, drawing cards to get more one-shots otherwise.

5: If, on playing his seventh unique one-shot you don't get the unlock, restart the match, increase the number of out-of-turn card draws by 1 and repeat steps 3-5.

 

If you get to 10 card draws, just stop, as it's clear that's too many and it means there's another condition needed, perhaps certain ongoings.
